mapper.insert: insert into ai_model_config ( model_name, model_type, api_key, base_url, enabled, priority, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{modelName}, #{modelType}, #{apiKey}, #{baseUrl}, #{enabled}, #{priority}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update ai_model_config set model_name = #{modelName}, model_type = #{modelType}, api_key = #{apiKey}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, enabled = #{enabled}, priority = #{priority}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, model_name, model_type, api_key, base_url, enabled, priority, created_at, updated_at from ai_model_config where id = #{id}

select mc.id, mc.model_name, mc.model_type, mc.api_key, mc.base_url, mc.enabled, mc.priority, mc.created_at, mc.updated_at, cap.id as cap_id, cap.model_id as cap_model_id, cap.max_input_tokens as cap_max_input_tokens, cap.max_output_tokens as cap_max_output_tokens, cap.support_function_calling as cap_support_function_calling, cap.support_vision as cap_support_vision, cap.support_streaming as cap_support_streaming, cap.quality_score as cap_quality_score, cap.created_at as cap_created_at, cap.updated_at as cap_updated_at from ai_model_config mc left join ai_model_capability cap on cap.model_id = mc.id where mc.id = #{id}
select id, model_name, model_type, api_key, base_url, enabled, priority, created_at, updated_at from ai_model_config where model_name = #{modelName}
select id, model_name, model_type, api_key, base_url, enabled, priority, created_at, updated_at from ai_model_config where model_type = #{modelType} and enabled = #{enabled}
select id, model_name, model_type, api_key, base_url, enabled, priority, created_at, updated_at from ai_model_config where enabled = #{enabled}
select id, model_name, model_type, api_key, base_url, enabled, priority, created_at, updated_at from ai_model_config where enabled = true
select id, model_name, model_type, api_key, base_url, enabled, priority, created_at, updated_at from ai_model_config where enabled = #{enabled} order by priority desc

select mc.id, mc.model_name, mc.model_type, mc.api_key, mc.base_url, mc.enabled, mc.priority, mc.created_at, mc.updated_at, cap.id as cap_id, cap.model_id as cap_model_id, cap.max_input_tokens as cap_max_input_tokens, cap.max_output_tokens as cap_max_output_tokens, cap.support_function_calling as cap_support_function_calling, cap.support_vision as cap_support_vision, cap.support_streaming as cap_support_streaming, cap.quality_score as cap_quality_score, cap.created_at as cap_created_at, cap.updated_at as cap_updated_at from ai_model_config mc left join ai_model_capability cap on cap.model_id = mc.id where mc.enabled = true
